description: Intent i005 (branch=xmit-softirq-lock, snapshot s04) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/mwl8k.c:1973-1978 'spin_lock(&priv->stream_lock);' — priv->stream_lock is taken with plain spin_lock() (no spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable at any of its sites: 1977/2041/2064/2114, 3817-3835, 4147-4166, 5437-5547) on the softirq-reachable xmit path mwl8k_tx (ieee80211_ops .tx at mwl8k.c:5589) -> mwl8k_txq_xmit (4685 call, function at 1883), which mac80211 reaches via drv_tx from __ieee80211_tx (net/mac80211/tx.c:1385/1265), executed both from .ndo_start_xmit = ieee80211_subif_start_xmit (iface.c:1124) and from the tx_pending tasklet (main.c:639, scheduled at util.c:356) with BH enabled — proven by the same function taking priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh (mwl8k.c:2049) and the TX-completion tasklet mwl8k_tx_poll doing likewise (4629). The identical lock is taken plainly from process/workqueue contexts: mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events worker (3800, lock at 3817) queued by ieee80211_queue_work from the hardirq handler mwl8k_interrupt (4600), mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (4147) via mwl8k_sta_remove (5303/5310, .sta_remove 5601), and mwl8k_ampdu_action (5437, .ampdu_action 5605, which even msleep(1000)s). A TX tasklet spinning on stream_lock on the same CPU as a preempted plain-holder produces a self-deadlock: soft lockup, RCU stall, TX-stall DoS — the exact ks7010 seed mechanism. UNRESOLVED candidates recorded: cw1200 wsm_cmd.lock (wsm.c:1093) and event_queue_lock (sta.c:124, wsm.c:940), hostap sta_table_lock (hostap_ap.c:230, 13 plain sites), iwlwifi pcie rxq->lock/irq_lock (rx.c:185,891) — surfaced but not fully classified. LIMITATIONS: bounded search ranked drivers/net/wireless and drivers/staging by plain-spin_lock density, deep analysis only for mwl8k; no runtime reproducer (no .config in snapshot); the mac80211 tasklet path is the confirmed BH-enabled softirq entry (ndo_start_xmit BH state not separately confirmed but not needed for the deadlock argument); ks7010 seed location deliberately not reported.
